title: Outside requests: the Name.com ticket's Pulse case appears; records fit their column
why: Jason, 2026-11-17: "not seeing pulse for ticket." Release #84 stored each request as one staff_settings value; the Name.com ticket's came to 262 characters, over the column's 255, so it wasn't stored, and the 'added once' marker written just before it stopped any retry. Requests are now kept compact (never over 250 characters; the long answer goes on the Pulse case as its note, up to 3,500 characters), and the seed checks for a request with ticket #3113488 rather than the marker, so it's added now (and never twice). Chase them now says to wait 5 days and write once: Name.com asks for no reply before they answer (a reply moves the ticket to the back of the queue). The card's form limits match (what 120 characters, link 90). The case is an Update, listed under System Health and Operational Queues; it turns to an Alert after 5 days.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
